releases.title: Vehicle Persistence, VIP Coins and Improvements

changes.text: Fixed the purchase interface for exclusive vehicles.
Fixed surface marker placement in Position Editor.
Added HUD visibility handling during test drives.
Added a diamond icon for exclusive vehicles.
Added VIP coin integration validation. Invalid integrations are now disabled automatically.
Exclusive vehicles now use regular payments when VIP coins are unavailable.
Added vehicle persistence compatibility with Kiminaze's AdvancedParking.
Added support for custom vehicle persistence providers.
Repossessed vehicles are now removed from the configured vehicle persistence system.
Applied Position Editor to dealership positions in Developer Mode.
Added Config.LeaseSettings.enabled to handle whether financing is enabled.
Added insurance compatibility, only resource by now is m-Insurance.
Added insurance config with configurable pricing.
